about:
Hello! I'm Sai Sreenadh, known professionally as STron, a student based in India. I specialize in UI design and full stack development, particularly with Next.js and Figma. I hold a B.Tech degree and am passionate about creating user-friendly interfaces and robust web applications.
When I'm not coding, I enjoy playing video games and reading books. My goal is to achieve success in the tech industry by continuously learning and innovating.
